title: Collection of Earlier Fees with the Kestrel Return Balance Payment
content:
**Plan terms — fees from before the return.** On a returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, the fees standing from before the return (the fees due balance less the return charges, never below zero) are collected with the return balance payment according to the contract's recent record:

- where no balloon late charge and no balloon returned payment was assessed or posted in the 12 calendar months ending on the payment date, 0 (none) of the fees standing from before the return is collected with the return balance payment;
- where one or more was assessed or posted in those months but none in the 6 calendar months ending on the payment date, 0.5 (half) of those fees is collected with it;
- otherwise all of them are collected with it.

A window of N calendar months ending on the payment date takes in the dates on or before the payment date that fall fewer than N whole calendar months before it.

## Table

| Late charges or returned payments in the 12 months | In the 6 months | Share of earlier fees collected now |
|---|---|---|
| None | None | 0 |
| One or more | None | 0.5 |
| One or more | One or more | All |

*Hypothetical:* earlier fees of USD 60.00 and a late charge eight months before the payment date with nothing in the last six months: USD 30.00 is collected now.
